partnershipPlan: A patient partner with a difficult airway letter reviews the plain-language summary and the letter template; the emergency department airway lead reviews the emergency episodes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I got a letter full of words I did not understand and put it in a drawer.
items.implication: Report awareness and review the letter's language.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the morning in the emergency department nobody opens the alerts tab.
items.implication: Report recognition by time of day and setting.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: There are eleven warnings on every record; the airway one looks like all the rest.
items.implication: Record the number of other warnings as a balancing measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I told them about his airway three times before anyone listened.
items.implication: Consider families as part of the alert chain.

summary: Four composite voices on the letter, out-of-hours care, alert fatigue and families.
